title: US-short weekly_report.md output contract (design §11.2) — const-pins the section set/order + mandatory honest-banner + price_clock fields
description: Batch-1 declarative shared contract for the human-readable weekly report. Pairs with us_short_action_table_contract (§11.3) to freeze the §11 output surface so the batch-3 renderer cannot drop/reorder/rename a section, drift a banner tag, weaken the lifecycle-count invariant, or omit a mandatory banner element. ALL governed identity is const-pinned here (the 13 sections incl. exact Chinese content+order, the 6 banner ids+tags+always_shown, price_clock fields+always_shown, the lifecycle-count invariant) — the schema is a self-sufficient validator, not shape-only. A test triangulates the sections const == preset == design §11.2 so the byte-exact Chinese never silently diverges. No report rendered, no data fetched.

sections.description: §11.2 the 13 ordered weekly_report.md sections — const-pinned (exact content AND order). Byte-faithful to design §11.2; a test triangulates this const == preset == design extraction so the three never silently diverge.
const: 最终操作表(精简一眼表)
字段·模块生命周期提醒

price_clock.description: §11.2 ④ price clock — 必显 (always_shown) + the 4 design-locked fields, so a render cannot omit the 'which prices/dates were used' disclosure.

mandatory_banner.description: §11.2 top honest banner — exactly 6 mandatory elements ①-⑥; id + tag + always_shown const-pinned per element (④ price_clock is always shown, the rest are conditional). ref stays descriptive (typed) — it carries the prose design anchor, not governed identity.

lifecycle_reminder_count_consistency.description: §11.2 design invariant — the lifecycle-reminder count in section 1 (本周运行状态) MUST equal the count in section 12 (字段·模块生命周期提醒). Pinned structurally (not prose) so the rule itself can't drift; the render-time count check is the batch-3 renderer.
